tab.profile.anonNote: Log in with Strava to see your own activities, and to manage your Heatflask account.
tab.profile.indexNote: We index your activity summaries for fast access.
tab.profile.sharedMapsNote: Off: only you can see your activities on Heatflask. On: anyone with a link to your map can see the activities you have made public on Strava. Your private ones stay yours either way. How privacy works
tab.profile.deleteConfirm:
Delete your Heatflask account?

This removes your indexed activities and revokes Heatflask's access to your Strava data. It cannot be undone.
tab.info.title: Info
tab.info.shiftDragDesc: Select activities in a box. On a touchscreen, tap first, then drag with one finger. The last activity selected shows its details, and the activity list scrolls to it.
tab.info.ctrlDragDesc: Rotate and tilt the map in 3D, or use two fingers
tab.info.liveUrlDesc: The map view and the animation settings are kept in the page's URL, so anyone you share it with sees the same view.
tab.info.videoDesc: The button records the animation as an MP4: tap it, size the box over the part of the map you want, and tap again to record. One full loop of the animation is recorded, so the video repeats seamlessly; a loop longer than {max} seconds (the longest video Strava accepts) is cut off at {max}.
